target_customer: Cafes, coffee shops, restaurants and bars in Mexico, from single locations to chains
problem: Mexican restaurants ran on clunky legacy POS and sales-heavy vendors; PoloTab offers modern POS, inventory, payments and invoicing that keeps working offline.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription from 990 MXN plus IVA per month, payment processing quoted separately

founders.name: Aldo Piaggio
education: Industrial engineering with a minor in economics, University of Michigan
founders.background_notes: Third generation of a Honduran food and beverage family business per YC page; designer.

founders.name: Juan Chomali
education: Mechanical engineering and economics, University of Michigan
previous_startups: Boreal (Hacker News iPhone client, removed by Apple)
founders.background_notes: Started coding at 12 per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: POS with offline mode, hardware, CFDI invoicing and delivery integrations is standard engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: POS systems are embedded in daily operations and invoicing compliance, though local competitors existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent acquiring or copying PoloTab; listed from third-party comparison pages, undated.

market_need_then: Mexico's restaurant software market was served by sales-heavy traditional vendors, per a VC Mexico interview; no hard demand metrics from 2022 or 2023 found.

branding.domain_note: Uses polotab.com; company legal entity is PoloPay Inc.

identity.visual_style: Design-led; CEO is a designer and the site pitches iPhone-like simplicity

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Restaurant software that actually works

rebrands.why: Not stated; YC lists both names, and the legal entity is still PoloPay Inc.

brand_strength.rationale: Named cafe customers on its site and good local review presence, but no press on the brand and the name collides with the Polo apparel brand.

outcome_analysis: PoloTab says more than 1,200 venues in 70 plus Mexican cities use it, up from about 800 in a 2025 profile, with a design-led product and founders from the food and beverage trade. Funding is unclear, with a reported small pre-seed and a 2024 seed whose size is not public, so growth may be largely self-funded.
notes: Funding conflicts: VCBacked and YesPress report a September 2024 seed with YC and Plug and Play (no amount); Bouncewatch and Startup-Seeker report a $500K pre-seed on 2023-04-05; Latka calls it bootstrapped with $1M revenue. All aggregator-only, so no round is recorded. Customer counts are company self-reports. The rebrand line reflects PoloPay as the legal name and is not confirmed as a dated rename. No dated 2023 competitor source was found (third-party pages list Clover, TouchBistro, Lightspeed, Toast undated). Update: a 500K seed dated 2023-01 is recorded from Seedtable, a single database; Bouncewatch dates a 500K pre-seed 2023-04-05 and VCBacked a 2024-09 seed with no amount, so these may be the same or separate rounds. No press release found.
